# Regenerative Cooling

This is an original COSMOS golden fixture. It cites NASA SP-8087 only as a
bibliographic identity and does not reproduce proprietary source prose.

The Bartz correlation is used for regenerative cooling of liquid-rocket nozzles.

Assumption: Coolant is treated as single-phase.

The Reynolds number is

$$ Re = rho * V * D / mu $$

A turbulent internal-flow estimate is

$$ Nu = 0.023 * Re^{0.8} * Pr^{0.4} $$

Maximum wall temperature shall not exceed the material temperature limit.
